quizData.question: (a+b)<sup>0</sup> = ?
quizData.explanationText: Any number raised to the power of 0 is always 1.
quizData.failureText: Any number raised to the power of 0 is always 1.

quizData.question: (a+b)<sup>1</sup> = ?
quizData.explanationText: Any number raised to the power of 1 is the number itself.
quizData.failureText: Any number raised to the power of 1 is the number itself.

quizData.question: (a+b)<sup>2</sup> = ?
quizData.explanationText:
Note:(a+b)<sup>2</sup> = (a+b) (a+b)
    = a(a+b) + b(a+b)
    = a<sup>2</sup> + ab + ab + b<sup>2</sup>
    = a<sup>2</sup> + 2ab + b<sup>2</sup>.
quizData.failureText:
Note:(a+b)<sup>2</sup> = (a+b) (a+b)
    = a(a+b) + b(a+b)
    = a<sup>2</sup> + ab + ab + b<sup>2</sup>
  = a<sup>2</sup> + 2ab + b<sup>2</sup>.
